forth.en: The speaker stepped forth to present the team's final proposal.
forth.zh: 講者走上前，提出團隊的最終提案。

forthcoming.en: The school announced details about the forthcoming science fair this morning.
forthcoming.zh: 學校今早公布了即將舉行的科展細節。

fortify.en: Engineers used stronger materials to fortify the bridge against severe weather.
fortify.zh: 工程師使用更堅固的材料強化橋梁，以抵抗惡劣天候。

fortunate.en: We were fortunate to finish the hike before the heavy rain began.
fortunate.zh: 我們很幸運，在大雨開始前完成了健行。

forum.en: The student forum gave everyone a chance to discuss campus improvements.
forum.zh: 學生論壇讓每個人都有機會討論校園改善。

forwards.en: The line moved forwards slowly as more passengers entered the station.
forwards.zh: 隨著更多乘客進站，隊伍慢慢向前移動。

fossil.en: The museum displayed a fossil discovered in a nearby mountain area.
fossil.zh: 博物館展出了一件在附近山區發現的化石。

foul.en: A foul smell from the drain caused the class to open the windows.
foul.zh: 排水孔傳來的惡臭讓全班打開窗戶。

found.en: Local volunteers helped found a community library for younger children.
found.zh: 地方志工協助成立一座供年幼孩童使用的社區圖書館。

founder.en: The founder explained how the small company grew over ten years.
founder.zh: 創辦人說明這家小公司如何在十年間成長。

fountain.en: Students gathered beside the fountain during the lunch break.
fountain.zh: 午休時，學生聚集在噴水池旁。

fowl.en: The farm raises several kinds of fowl in a large outdoor area.
fowl.zh: 這座農場在大型戶外區域飼養數種家禽。

fox.en: A fox appeared near the forest trail just before sunset.
fox.zh: 日落前，一隻狐狸出現在森林步道附近。

fraction.en: Only a small fraction of the class chose the most difficult topic.
fraction.zh: 全班只有一小部分選擇了最困難的主題。

fracture.en: The doctor confirmed a minor fracture after examining the X-ray.
fracture.zh: 醫師查看 X 光後確認有輕微骨折。

fragment.en: Researchers examined each pottery fragment before rebuilding the ancient bowl.
fragment.zh: 研究人員在重建古碗前，檢查每一片陶器碎片。

fragrance.en: The fragrance of fresh flowers filled the small exhibition room.
fragrance.zh: 新鮮花朵的香氣充滿了小型展覽室。

fragrant.en: The garden was filled with fragrant herbs after the spring rain.
fragrant.zh: 春雨過後，花園裡充滿芳香的香草氣味。

frame.en: The photographer adjusted the frame before taking the final picture.
frame.zh: 攝影師在拍下最後一張照片前調整了畫面構圖。

franchise.en: The company opened its first overseas franchise near the train station.
franchise.zh: 這家公司在火車站附近開設第一家海外加盟店。

frank.en: She gave a frank answer when the group asked about the problem.
frank.zh: 小組詢問問題時，她坦率地回答。

frantic.en: The office became frantic when the network suddenly stopped working.
frantic.zh: 網路突然停止運作時，辦公室變得一片忙亂。

fraud.en: The article explains how consumers can recognize common forms of fraud.
fraud.zh: 這篇文章說明消費者如何辨識常見的詐騙形式。

freak.en: A freak storm interrupted the outdoor concert without any warning.
freak.zh: 一場異常暴風雨毫無預警地中斷了戶外音樂會。

freeway.en: Traffic slowed on the freeway because of heavy rain during rush hour.
freeway.zh: 尖峰時段的大雨使高速公路車流變慢。

freeze.en: Water will freeze when the temperature remains below zero long enough.
freeze.zh: 當溫度長時間維持在零度以下，水就會結冰。

freezer.en: The ice cream should remain in the freezer until dessert is served.
freezer.zh: 冰淇淋在甜點上桌前應一直放在冷凍庫。

freight.en: The port handles large amounts of freight arriving from overseas.
freight.zh: 這座港口處理大量從海外抵達的貨運。

frequency.en: The survey measured the frequency of exercise among high school students.
frequency.zh: 這份調查測量高中生運動的頻率。

frequent.en: Frequent practice helped her become more confident during presentations.
frequent.zh: 頻繁練習幫助她在簡報時更有自信。

freshman.en: Every freshman attends an orientation session during the first week.
freshman.zh: 每位大一新生都會在第一週參加新生說明會。

friction.en: Friction between the tires and road helps the bicycle stop safely.
friction.zh: 輪胎與路面之間的摩擦力幫助腳踏車安全停下。

fridge.en: Please put the leftover food in the fridge before leaving.
fridge.zh: 離開前請把剩下的食物放進冰箱。

friendship.en: Their friendship grew stronger after they worked on the project together.
friendship.zh: 他們一起做專題後，友誼變得更深厚。

fries.en: He ordered a sandwich with a small serving of fries.
fries.zh: 他點了一份三明治和一小份薯條。

fright.en: The sudden noise gave everyone a brief fright during the rehearsal.
fright.zh: 排練時的突然聲響把大家嚇了一跳。

frog.en: A small frog jumped into the pond beside the path.
frog.zh: 一隻小青蛙跳進步道旁的池塘。

frontier.en: Space research continues to push the frontier of scientific knowledge.
frontier.zh: 太空研究持續拓展科學知識的前沿。

frost.en: A thin layer of frost covered the grass early in the morning.
frost.zh: 清晨時草地覆蓋著一層薄霜。

frown.en: He began to frown when the instructions became difficult to understand.
frown.zh: 當說明變得難以理解時，他開始皺眉。

frustration.en: She took a short break when frustration made the task harder.
frustration.zh: 當挫折感讓任務變得更困難時，她短暫休息了一下。

fry.en: The cook used a shallow pan to fry the vegetables quickly.
fry.zh: 廚師用淺鍋快速煎炒蔬菜。

fuel.en: The new bus uses less fuel than the older model.
fuel.zh: 這款新公車比舊型號使用更少燃料。

fulfill.en: The program helps students fulfill the community service requirement.
fulfill.zh: 這項計畫幫助學生完成社區服務要求。

fulfillment.en: She found fulfillment in helping younger students improve their reading skills.
fulfillment.zh: 她從幫助年幼學生提升閱讀能力中獲得成就感。

fume.en: A strange fume from the machine caused workers to leave the room.
fume.zh: 機器散發的異常氣體讓工作人員離開房間。

functional.en: The old computer is slow but still functional for basic tasks.
functional.zh: 這台舊電腦雖然很慢，但仍能處理基本工作。

funeral.en: The family held a quiet funeral and invited close relatives.
funeral.zh: 這家人舉行了一場安靜的喪禮，邀請近親參加。

funny.en: The funny story made the whole class laugh during the break.
funny.zh: 那個有趣的故事讓全班在下課時笑了起來。

fur.en: The animal's thick fur helps it survive cold mountain winters.
fur.zh: 這種動物濃密的毛皮幫助牠度過寒冷的山區冬季。

furious.en: She was furious when the team ignored the agreed safety rules.
furious.zh: 團隊忽視事先同意的安全規則時，她非常生氣。

furnish.en: The school plans to furnish the new study room with larger desks.
furnish.zh: 學校計畫為新自習室配置較大的書桌。

furniture.en: The library replaced old furniture to create more comfortable study areas.
furniture.zh: 圖書館更換舊家具，打造更舒適的讀書空間。

further.en: Further research is needed before the scientists can confirm the result.
further.zh: 科學家在確認結果前，還需要進一步研究。

fury.en: The storm reached its greatest fury shortly before midnight.
fury.zh: 暴風雨在午夜前不久達到最猛烈的程度。

fuse.en: Engineers designed the parts to fuse together under controlled heat.
fuse.zh: 工程師設計這些零件，使它們能在受控加熱下融合。

fuss.en: There was little fuss when the schedule changed at the last minute.
fuss.zh: 行程臨時更改時，大家並沒有太多抱怨。

galaxy.en: The telescope captured a distant galaxy far beyond our solar system.
galaxy.zh: 望遠鏡拍攝到一個遠在太陽系之外的星系。

gallery.en: The gallery displays paintings created by local high school students.
gallery.zh: 這間藝廊展出當地高中生創作的畫作。

gallon.en: The container can hold nearly one gallon of clean water.
gallon.zh: 這個容器可以裝將近一加侖的乾淨水。

gallop.en: The horse began to gallop across the field after the gate opened.
gallop.zh: 柵門打開後，馬開始在田野上奔馳。

gamble.en: It would be a gamble to launch the project without testing it first.
gamble.zh: 在沒有先測試的情況下啟動專案會是一場冒險。

gang.en: The documentary examines how a street gang affected the neighborhood.
gang.zh: 這部紀錄片探討街頭幫派如何影響社區。

gangster.en: The old film portrays a gangster trying to escape from the police.
gangster.zh: 這部老電影描寫一名試圖逃離警方追捕的黑幫人物。

garbage.en: Students separated recyclable materials from ordinary garbage after lunch.
garbage.zh: 學生午餐後把可回收物與一般垃圾分開。

gardener.en: The gardener planted new flowers along the path near the library.
gardener.zh: 園丁在圖書館附近的小徑旁種下新花朵。

garlic.en: The soup has a mild garlic flavor that becomes stronger when heated.
garlic.zh: 這道湯有淡淡的蒜味，加熱後會更明顯。

garment.en: Each garment was labeled with washing instructions before being displayed.
garment.zh: 每件衣物在展示前都標上洗滌說明。

gasoline.en: The report compares gasoline use with electricity use in transportation.
gasoline.zh: 這份報告比較交通運輸中汽油與電力的使用。

gasp.en: The audience gave a gasp when the final result appeared on screen.
gasp.zh: 最終結果出現在螢幕上時，觀眾驚呼了一聲。

gathering.en: The annual gathering brings former students back to visit the school.
gathering.zh: 年度聚會讓畢業校友回到學校參訪。

gauge.en: Teachers use short quizzes to gauge how well students understand the lesson.
gauge.zh: 老師用小考衡量學生對課程內容的理解程度。

gay.en: The article discusses how schools can support gay students with respect.
gay.zh: 這篇文章討論學校如何以尊重的方式支持同志學生。

gaze.en: She paused to gaze at the stars above the quiet campsite.
gaze.zh: 她停下來凝視安靜營地上方的星空。

gear.en: The cycling club checks every piece of gear before long trips.
gear.zh: 自行車社在長途活動前會檢查每件裝備。

gene.en: A gene can influence certain traits passed from parents to children.
gene.zh: 基因可能影響由父母傳給子女的某些特徵。

generator.en: The backup generator kept essential lights working during the power outage.
generator.zh: 停電時，備用發電機讓必要照明持續運作。

generosity.en: Her generosity encouraged other students to donate books to the program.
generosity.zh: 她的慷慨鼓勵其他學生也捐書給這項計畫。

genetics.en: The class studied basic genetics through simple examples of inherited traits.
genetics.zh: 課堂透過遺傳特徵的簡單例子學習基礎遺傳學。

genius.en: The inventor was praised as a genius after solving the complex problem.
genius.zh: 這位發明家解決複雜問題後，被讚為天才。

genre.en: Students chose one literary genre to analyze for their final report.
genre.zh: 學生選擇一種文學類型作為期末報告分析主題。

gentleman.en: The elderly gentleman thanked the students for helping carry his bags.
gentleman.zh: 那位年長紳士感謝學生幫忙提袋子。

geographical.en: The map shows geographical differences between coastal and mountain regions.
geographical.zh: 這張地圖顯示沿海與山區之間的地理差異。

geometry.en: Geometry helps students understand shapes, angles, and spatial relationships.
geometry.zh: 幾何幫助學生理解形狀、角度與空間關係。

germ.en: Washing your hands can reduce the spread of each harmful germ.
germ.zh: 洗手可以減少每種有害病菌的傳播。

ghost.en: The story describes a friendly ghost living in an abandoned house.
ghost.zh: 故事描述一個住在廢棄房屋裡的友善鬼魂。

giant.en: A giant tree stood at the center of the old village square.
giant.zh: 一棵巨大的樹矗立在老村莊廣場中央。

gifted.en: The gifted student also worked hard to improve weak areas.
gifted.zh: 這位有天分的學生也努力改善自己的弱項。

gigantic.en: A gigantic screen displayed the results during the school festival.
gigantic.zh: 校慶期間，一面巨大的螢幕顯示活動結果。

giggle.en: Several students began to giggle when the teacher told a joke.
giggle.zh: 老師講笑話時，幾位學生開始咯咯笑。

ginger.en: She added a small piece of ginger to the warm tea.
ginger.zh: 她在熱茶裡加入一小片薑。

giraffe.en: A giraffe can reach leaves growing high above many other animals.
giraffe.zh: 長頸鹿能吃到比許多其他動物更高處的葉子。

glacier.en: The glacier has become smaller as average temperatures have risen.
glacier.zh: 隨著平均氣溫上升，這座冰河已經縮小。

glamorous.en: The job looked glamorous from outside but required long hours of preparation.
glamorous.zh: 這份工作從外表看很光鮮，但需要長時間準備。

glamour.en: The documentary looks beyond the glamour of the fashion industry.
glamour.zh: 這部紀錄片探討時尚產業光鮮亮麗表面之外的一面。

glance.en: She took a quick glance at the schedule before leaving the classroom.
glance.zh: 離開教室前，她快速看了一眼行程表。

glare.en: The glare from the screen made the text difficult to read.
glare.zh: 螢幕反光讓文字變得難以閱讀。

glasses.en: He cleaned his glasses before reading the small print on the chart.
glasses.zh: 他在閱讀圖表上的小字前先擦乾淨眼鏡。

gleam.en: A faint gleam of sunlight appeared through the clouds after the storm.
gleam.zh: 暴風雨過後，一絲微弱陽光穿過雲層。

glide.en: The bird seemed to glide smoothly above the lake without effort.
glide.zh: 那隻鳥似乎毫不費力地在湖面上方平穩滑翔。

glimpse.en: We caught a brief glimpse of the mountain before clouds covered it.
glimpse.zh: 雲層遮住山峰前，我們短暫瞥見了它。

glitter.en: Tiny drops of rain began to glitter in the afternoon sunlight.
glitter.zh: 細小雨滴開始在午後陽光下閃閃發亮。

globe.en: The teacher used a globe to explain the location of major oceans.
globe.zh: 老師用地球儀說明主要海洋的位置。
